Parking management
description:
Parking Management System – Project Idea & Pitch
A Parking Management System (PMS) is a smart software application designed to manage parking spaces efficiently. It helps drivers find available parking spaces, book slots, make payments, and avoid wasting time searching for parking.

You can present this idea as a modern technology-based solution to everyday parking problems.
1. The problem we are solving
In cities, shopping centres, universities, hospitals and offices, parking can be difficult because:
- Drivers waste time searching for empty parking spaces.
- There is no easy way to check parking availability before arriving.
- Manual parking management can cause errors.
- Drivers sometimes park in unauthorised spaces.
- Parking payments and entry/exit records can be difficult to manage.
- Parking owners struggle to monitor occupancy and revenue.  
The system will allow users to:
1. Register and log in.
2. Search for nearby parking locations.
3. View available and occupied parking spaces.
4. Reserve a parking space.
5. Receive a unique QR code for entry.
6. Make online parking payments.
7. Track parking duration and costs.
8. Receive notifications before their booking expires.
Administrators will have a dashboard to manage parking spaces, bookings, payments and reports.
problem: Drivers waste time searching for available parking spaces due to poor parking management and lack of real-time availability. Our system solves this by helping users quickly find, book and pay for parking spaces online, reducing traffic, frustration and wasted time.
solution: Develop a Smart Parking Management System that allows users to find available parking spaces, check real-time availability, book slots, make online payments and access parking using QR codes. It also helps parking owners manage spaces, bookings and payments efficiently.
businessModel: How can a Parking Management System earn money? 1. Booking Commission: Earn 5–10% on every parking reservation. 2. Monthly Subscription: Charge parking owners £49–£199 per month to use your software. 3. Premium Booking: Charge extra for guaranteed or priority parking. 4. Advertising: Earn money by promoting nearby businesses. 5. EV Partnerships: Earn commissions from electric vehicle charging services. 6.
